checklist.item: Every screen has defined empty / loading / error states
Every component lists the exact data fields it consumes
No ambiguous "TBD" left in the spec

summary: Translated product-spec.md into an Angular UI design covering login, device list, device detail (live 24h sensor chart), and a global + device-scoped alert panel. All screens define loading/empty/error/offline/stale-feed states. Component contracts specify exact @Input/@Output data shapes for every component. Design tokens (color, spacing, typography, chart, breakpoints) are in design-tokens.json.

open_questions.question: Exact sensor channel taxonomy for dosing devices (names/units) is not specified in the product spec.
open_questions.resolution_in_this_handoff: SensorChartComponent and DeviceDetail.channels[] are generic/backend-driven (channelId, label, unit) so UI doesn't hardcode sensor types.

open_questions.question: Realtime transport for live chart updates and sub-30s alert delivery (SignalR/WebSocket vs. polling) is not specified.
open_questions.impact: non-blocking for UI (components consume an Observable stream regardless), but affects Agent B's architecture and whether the 30s alert-latency SLA is achievable.
open_questions.resolution_in_this_handoff: UI assumes a push-capable stream with a 'connected/reconnecting/disconnected' status surfaced to the user.

open_questions.question: Identity provider / auth mechanism for 'authenticated operators' is not specified.
open_questions.impact: non-blocking for UI (LoginComponent + route guard are IdP-agnostic).
open_questions.resolution_in_this_handoff: UI assumes OIDC/OAuth2-style session; LoginComponent supports a password-form path and can be swapped for SSO redirect without contract changes.
